# Industry Army Marketing

> Exclusive-territory digital marketing for trade contractors and service pros across Canada. One contractor per trade per city on 80+ premium 20-year-old industry domains, starting at $10/month.

Industry Army Marketing (IAM) operates a network of premium, aged, niche-relevant trade domains (.ca, .io, .tv, .ltd). Each city/trade slot is locked to a single contractor — permanent dofollow placement, EyeSpyr-verified, no agency markup. Pricing scales by city population: $10 per 100,000 residents per month, minimum $10. Custom packages available for websites, product sales, multi-location, and enterprise accounts.
